findings.text: COUPLING_BUDGET holds the row's other error term itself (1.147e-04, 3.244e-05, 1.040e-04, 3.348e-05) and FALLBACK_BUDGET at line 219 holds the fan's refinement floor itself (2.924e-16, 5.109e-15, 5.064e-15), not the one tenth the plan's row-margin table states and this file's own docstring at line 8 and comment at line 206 both claim, so the gate is one decade loose: the receipts report the smallest arc vertex count meeting the budget as 32/64/32/64 on the four coupling rows where a tenth of the stated term gives 64/128/128/128, and they report meets_budget true at 128 vertices on four of the five fan-floor rows where the tenth rule gives none at any count — turning the margin the plan says must not be read as a pass or a fail into a pass, and understating the vertex count any section that sizes the arc from this headline would use by one to two doublings (mislabelled fence).
